fields.description_en: 1: Married and living together "(living together for 6 months or more in a year)", 2: Married, not currently living together regularly "(not living together for 6 months or more in a year)", 3: Divorced, 4: (Legally) separated, 5: Cohabiting/unmarried, 6: Father deceased, 7: Mother deceased, 8: Both parents deceased

fields.name_zh: 您覺得他"目前"的健康狀況是很好、好、普通、不太好、還是很不好呢？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you consider his/her "current" health to be very good, good, fair, not very good, or very poor?
fields.description_en: 1: Very good, 2: Good, 3: Fair, 4: Not very good, 5: Very poor

fields.name_zh: 您覺得他"目前"的健康狀況和"同年齡的小朋友"比較起來，是好很多、有點好、差不多、有點差，還是差很多？
fields.description_zh: 1：好很多、2：有點好、3：差不多、4：有點差、5：差很多
fields.name_zh_en: Compared with "children of the same age", do you consider his/her "current" health to be much better, somewhat better, about the same, somewhat worse, or much worse?
fields.description_en: 1: Much better, 2: Somewhat better, 3: About the same, 4: Somewhat worse, 5: Much worse

fields.name_zh: 小朋友的年齡是
fields.description_zh: 1：未滿 1 歲【跳問 B4】、2：滿1歲及以上【續問 B3a】
fields.name_zh_en: The child's age is
fields.description_en: 1: Under 1 year old [skip to B4], 2: Aged 1 and over [continue to B3a]

fields.name_zh: "和一年前比"起來，您覺得他"目前"的健康狀況是：
fields.description_zh: 1：比一年前好很多、2：比一年前好一些、3：和一年前差不多、4：比一年前差一些、5：比一年前差很多
fields.name_zh_en: "Compared with one year ago", how is his/her health "currently"?
fields.description_en: 1: Much better than a year ago, 2: Somewhat better than a year ago, 3: About the same as a year ago, 4: Somewhat worse than a year ago, 5: Much worse than a year ago

fields.name_zh: "過去半年內"，他有沒有因為生病或受傷而無法上學(包括幼兒園、托兒所)呢？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past six months", has he/she been unable to attend school (including kindergarten and daycare) because of illness or injury?
fields.description_en: 0: No, 1: Yes, 2: Not yet in school

fields.name_zh: 這種情形"共有"幾天？
fields.name_zh_en: How many days in total did this situation last?

fields.name_zh: 請問他現在的身高是多少公分？
fields.name_zh_en: What is his/her current height in cm?

fields.name_zh: 請問他現在的體重是多少公斤？
fields.name_zh_en: What is his/her current weight in kg?

fields.name_zh: 【訪員填寫】小朋友的身高數值是口述還是實際測量的？
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer to fill in] Was the child's height value reported verbally or actually measured?

fields.name_zh: 【訪員填寫】小朋友的體重數值是口述還是實際測量的？
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer to fill in] Was the child's weight value reported verbally or actually measured?

fields.name_zh: 請問過去他是否"曾經"有氣喘發作或呼吸時有從胸部發出的咻咻聲？
fields.name_zh_en: Has he/she "ever" had asthma attacks or wheezing sounds from the chest when breathing?

fields.name_zh: 請問"過去12個月"他是否曾經有氣喘發作或呼吸時有從胸部發出的咻咻聲？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past 12 months", has he/she had asthma attacks or wheezing sounds from the chest when breathing?

fields.name_zh: "過去12個月"，他曾經發生過幾次氣喘發作或呼吸時有從胸部發出的咻咻聲？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past 12 months", how many times has he/she had asthma attacks or wheezing sounds from the chest when breathing?

fields.name_zh: "過去12個月"，他平均多久會因氣喘發作而中斷睡眠醒過來？
fields.description_zh:
0：從來沒有、1：每星期少於一次、
2：每星期一次或多於一次、3：分房睡，不知道
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past 12 months," on average how often did he wake from sleep due to an asthma attack?
fields.description_en:
0: Never, 1: Less than once a week,
2: Once a week or more, 3: Sleep in separate rooms, do not know

fields.name_zh: "過去12個月"，他是否曾因氣喘發作、呼吸困難，嚴重到呼吸之間只能講1到2個字？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past 12 months", has he/she had an asthma attack or breathing difficulty so severe that he/she could speak only 1 to 2 words between breaths?
fields.description_en: 0: No, 1: Yes, 2: The child cannot speak yet

fields.name_zh: 他過去是否"曾經"被醫師診斷有氣喘？
fields.name_zh_en: Has he/she "ever" been diagnosed with asthma by a physician?

fields.name_zh: "過去12個月"，他是否有活動或運動引發的咳嗽或氣喘？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past 12 months", did he/she have cough or wheezing triggered by activity or exercise?

fields.name_zh: "過去12個月"，他是否曾在沒有感冒、肺部或支氣管感染的情況下，但夜間卻有乾咳的現象？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past 12 months", has he/she had a dry cough at night without having a cold or lung or bronchial infection?

fields.name_zh: 空氣污染
fields.name_zh_en: air pollution

fields.name_zh_en: Hair/fur of pets such as cats and dogs

fields.name_zh: 冰冷食物
fields.name_zh_en: Cold food

fields.name_zh: 塵螨
fields.name_zh_en: Dust mites

fields.name_zh: 花粉、乾草
fields.name_zh_en: Pollen, hay

fields.name_zh: 氣溫急劇變化

fields.name_zh: 病毒感染（如感冒）
fields.name_zh_en: Viral infection (such as a cold)

fields.name_zh: 劇烈運動
fields.name_zh_en: Vigorous exercise

fields.name_zh: 藥物（如阿斯匹靈）
fields.name_zh_en: Medication (e.g., aspirin)

fields.name_zh: 激烈情緒反應（如大笑、大哭）
fields.name_zh_en: Intense emotional reactions (such as laughing or crying hard)

fields.name_zh: 蚊香、燒香
fields.name_zh_en: Mosquito coil, incense burning

fields.name_zh: 菸品燃燒的煙霧
fields.name_zh_en: Smoke from burning tobacco products

fields.name_zh: 其他影響因素
fields.name_zh_en: Other contributing factors

fields.name_zh: 不知道是什麼因素
fields.name_zh_en: know what factors

fields.name_zh: 他"現在"有沒有在使用治療氣喘的藥 (指醫師開的處方藥)？
fields.description_zh:
0：沒有、1：偶爾或必要時使用、
2：經常或按時使用
fields.name_zh_en: Is he "currently" using medication to treat asthma (i.e., physician-prescribed medication)?
fields.description_en:
0: No, 1: Occasional or as-needed use,
2: Frequent or regular use

fields.name_zh: "最近一年內"，他有沒有定期回門診追蹤氣喘？
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past year", has he/she had regular outpatient follow-up for asthma?

fields.name_zh: "最近一年內"，他有沒有因為氣喘發作，而至"急診"就醫？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year", has he/she gone to the "emergency department" because of an asthma attack?

fields.name_zh: 最近一年內，他有幾次因為氣喘發作，而至急診就醫？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past year, how many times has he/she gone to the emergency room because of an asthma attack?

fields.name_zh: "最近一年內"，他有沒有因為氣喘而"住院"？
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past year", has he/she been "hospitalized" because of asthma?

fields.name_zh: "最近一年內"，他有幾次因為氣喘而"住院"？
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past year", how many times has he/she been "hospitalized" because of asthma?

fields.name_zh: 【系統查核】小朋友的年齡是
fields.description_zh: 1：未滿6歲【跳問 B7】、2：滿6歲及以上【續問 B6q】
fields.name_zh_en: [System check] The child's age is
fields.description_en: 1: Under 6 years old [skip to B7], 2: Aged 6 and over [continue to B6q]

fields.name_zh: 他平常是否使用"「尖峰呼氣流速計」"測量肺功能？
fields.name_zh_en: Does he/she usually use a "peak expiratory flow meter" to measure lung function?

fields.name_zh: 他使用"「尖峰呼氣流速計」"測量肺功能的頻率如何？
fields.name_zh_en: How often does he/she use a "peak expiratory flow meter" to measure lung function?

fields.name_zh: 請問他有沒有戴助聽器或"人工電子耳"？
fields.name_zh_en: Does he/she wear a hearing aid or "cochlear implant"?

fields.name_zh: 他聽聲音是否聽得清楚？
fields.description_zh: 0：沒有問題，聽得清楚、1：有點問題，聽不太清楚、2：一點也不清楚，幾乎全聾
fields.name_zh_en: Can he hear sounds clearly?
fields.description_en: 0: No problem, can hear clearly, 1: Some problem, cannot hear very clearly, 2: Cannot hear clearly at all, almost completely deaf

fields.name_zh: 他戴的是助聽器還是人工電子耳呢？
fields.name_zh_en: Is he/she wearing a hearing aid or a cochlear implant?

fields.name_zh: 他戴助聽器/人工電子耳後，聽聲音是否聽得清楚？
fields.description_zh: 0：沒有問題，聽得清楚、1：有點問題，聽不太清楚、2：一點也不清楚，幾乎全聾
fields.name_zh_en: After wearing a hearing aid/cochlear implant, can he/she hear sounds clearly?
fields.description_en: 0: No problem, can hear clearly, 1: Some problem, cannot hear very clearly, 2: Cannot hear clearly at all, almost completely deaf

fields.name_zh: 【系統查核】小朋友的年齡是
fields.description_zh: 1：未滿 6 歲【續問 B7b】、2：滿6歲及以上【跳問 B7c】
fields.name_zh_en: [System check] The child's age is
fields.description_en: 1: Under 6 years old [continue to B7b], 2: Aged 6 and over [skip to B7c]

fields.name_zh_en: Is he already attending kindergarten?

fields.name_zh_en: Has he had a hearing screening?

fields.name_zh: 他到目前為止聽力是否正常？
fields.name_zh_en: Has his/her hearing been normal so far?

fields.name_zh: 新生兒聽力篩檢
fields.name_zh_en: Newborn hearing screening

fields.name_zh: 學前兒童聽力篩檢
fields.name_zh_en: Preschool child hearing screening

fields.name_zh: 其他聽力檢查
fields.name_zh_en: Other hearing tests

fields.name_zh: 請問"新生兒聽力篩檢"檢查結果是否正常？
fields.name_zh_en: Is the result of the "newborn hearing screening" normal?

fields.name_zh: 請問"學前兒童聽力篩檢"檢查結果是否正常？
fields.name_zh_en: Is the result of the "preschool child hearing screening" normal?

fields.name_zh: 請問"其他聽力檢查"檢查結果是否正常？
fields.name_zh_en: Is the result of the "other hearing test" normal?

fields.name_zh: 請問"不知道是哪一種聽力篩檢"檢查結果是否正常？
fields.name_zh_en: Is the result of the examination "do not know which type of hearing screening" normal?

fields.name_zh_en: Do you think mild to moderate hearing loss needs to be checked with hearing instruments?
fields.description_en: 0: Do not know, 1: Needed, 2: Not needed

fields.name_zh_en: Do you think unilateral mild to moderate hearing loss will affect a child's learning?
fields.description_en: 0: Do not know, 1: Will, 2: Will not

fields.name_zh: 您知不知道政府有提供新生兒聽力篩檢補助？

3: Poorly designed stairs, 4: Insufficient lighting,
5: Stepped on or kicked something on the floor, 6: Bumped into table legs or furniture, 7: Vehicle suddenly started or braked abruptly, 8: Sudden dizziness or vision blacking out, 9: Sudden chest pain, palpitations, or breathlessness, 10: Sudden weakness in the thighs, 11: Poor eyesight, could not see clearly, 12: Other

fields.description_en: 1: Much better, 2: Somewhat better, 3: About the same, 4: Somewhat worse, 5: Much worse

fields.description_zh: 0：沒有健康問題、1：有健康問題，但沒有受到限制、2：有受到限制，但不嚴重、3：受到嚴重的限制
fields.name_zh_en: Do you currently have limitations in daily activities due to a health problem that has lasted more than 6 months? If so, how severe is this limitation?
fields.description_en: 0: No health problem, 1: Has a health problem but not limited, 2: Limited but not seriously, 3: Seriously limited

fields.name_zh: 您有任何"已經持續了 6個月以上，或預期將會持續 6個月以上"的"慢性"疾病或健康問題嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have any "chronic" disease or health problem that "has lasted 6 months or more, or is expected to last 6 months or more"?

fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer check] Who answered question B2b (the previous question)?

fields.name_zh: 您是不是"曾經"患有高血壓？【不包括懷孕時發生但產後痊癒的高血壓】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you "ever" had hypertension? [Excluding hypertension that occurred during pregnancy but resolved after delivery]

fields.description_zh:

2：經常或按時服用
fields.name_zh_en: Are you currently taking "doctor-prescribed" blood pressure-lowering medication?
fields.description_en:
0: No, 1: Occasional or as-needed use,
2: Frequent or regular use

fields.name_zh_en: Were you told by a medical professional?

fields.name_zh: 注射胰島素
fields.name_zh_en: insulin injection

fields.name_zh: 口服降血糖的藥物
fields.name_zh_en: oral hypoglycemic drugs

fields.description_en: 1: At least once a month, 2: At least once every 3 months, 3: At least once every six months, 4: At least once a year, 5: Irregularly

fields.name_zh_en: In the past year, have you had "a glycated hemoglobin test specifically because of diabetes (a test of average blood glucose over three months)"?

fields.name_zh_en: Do you "self-test blood glucose in order to control diabetes"?

fields.description_en: 1: Every day/several times a day, 2: Once every 2-3 days, 3: Once every 4-6 days, 4: Once a week or less often

fields.name_zh: 保持腳的清潔及乾燥
fields.name_zh_en: Keep feet clean and dry

fields.name_zh: 穿棉質襪
fields.name_zh_en: Wear cotton socks

fields.name_zh: 其他保養方法

fields.name_zh_en: Apart from taking medication, do you "measure your blood glucose" in daily life? (If yes) How often?
fields.description_en:
1: (Almost) never, 2: At least once a year,
3: At least once every 6 months, 4: At least once every 3 months, 5: At least once a month, 6: 2-3 times a month, 7: 1-2 times a week, 8: Almost every day

fields.name_zh: 請問除了吃藥之外，在日常生活上，您有沒有"量血脂"？(若有)多久量一次？

1：(幾乎)沒有、2：至少每年 1次、

fields.name_zh_en: Apart from taking medication, do you "measure your blood lipids" in daily life? (If yes) How often?
fields.description_en:

3: At least once every 6 months, 4: At least once every 3 months, 5: At least once a month, 6: 2-3 times a month, 7: 1-2 times a week, 8: Almost every day

fields.name_zh: "過去的12個月內"，您因為氣喘發作而到"急診"就醫幾次？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past 12 months", how many times did you go to the "emergency department" because of an asthma attack?

fields.name_zh: "過去的12個月內"，您是否曾因為氣喘病情惡化而"住院"治療？

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾經喝過酒？（包括各種酒類、保力達B、維士比與藥酒，"但不包括煮菜時加進去的的極少量或酒精成分已揮發的酒，或舔一下"）
fields.description_zh: 0：沒有（滴酒不沾）、1：有"(偶爾或應酬時才喝也算)"
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever drunk alcohol? (Including all kinds of alcoholic beverages, Baoliting B, Weishibi, and medicinal liquor, "but excluding a very small amount added when cooking or alcohol whose ethanol has evaporated, or a lick")
fields.description_en: 0: No (do not drink at all), 1: Yes "(including drinking only occasionally or at social occasions)"

fields.name_zh: 您第一次喝酒的年齡是幾足歲？

fields.name_zh: 您"最近一次"喝酒是什麼時候？
fields.description_zh: 1：最近七天、2：超過一星期至一個月內、3：超過一個月至半年內、4：超過半年至一年內 、5：超過一年以上
fields.name_zh_en: When did you "last" drink alcohol?
fields.description_en: 1: Last seven days, 2: More than one week up to one month, 3: More than one month up to six months, 4: More than six months up to one year, 5: More than one year

fields.name_zh_en: On the days in the past month that you drank, on average how many drinks did you have at one time? (Note: 1 drink = 1 can (350 cc) of beer, 1 glass (120 cc) of red wine, or 1 small cup (45 cc) of sorghum liquor or spirits)
fields.description_en: 1: Less than 1 drink, 2: 1 to 4 drinks, 3: 5 to 11 drinks, 4: 12 to 19 drinks, 5: 20 drinks or more

fields.name_zh: 過去一個月內有幾天一次喝 5杯或5杯以上？(註：1杯酒 = 1罐(350 cc)啤酒、1杯(120 cc)紅酒、或 1小杯(45 cc)高粱或烈酒)
fields.name_zh_en: In the past month, on how many days did you drink 5 or more drinks at one time? (Note: 1 drink = 1 can (350 cc) of beer, 1 glass (120 cc) of red wine, or 1 small cup (45 cc) of sorghum liquor or spirits)
fields.description_en:
1: 0 days, 2: 1 to 2 days, 3: 3 to 5 days, 4: 6 to 9 days, 5: 10 to 19 days,
6: 20 to 29 days, 7: The whole month

fields.name_zh: 過去一個月，有幾天您喝醉酒？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past month, on how many days did you get drunk?
fields.description_en:
1: 0 days (did not get drunk), 2: 1 or 2 days,
3: 3 to 5 days, 4: 6 to 9 days, 5: 10 to 19 days, 6: 20 to 29 days, 7: The whole month

fields.name_zh: 您"最近一次喝醉酒"是什麼時候？
fields.description_zh:
0：從來都沒有喝醉、1：最近七天、2：超過一星期至一個月內、
3：超過一個月至半年內、4：超過半年至一年內、5：超過一年以上
fields.name_zh_en: When did you "last get drunk"?
fields.description_en:
0: Never drunk, 1: Within the last 7 days, 2: More than 1 week to 1 month ago,
3: More than 1 month to 6 months ago, 4: More than 6 months to 1 year ago, 5: More than 1 year ago

fields.name_zh: 過去一年內，您大約"多久喝一次酒"？
fields.description_zh: 1：每月不到 1 次、2：每月 1~2次、3：每週 1 次、4：兩、三天喝1次、5：(幾乎)每天喝
fields.name_zh_en: In the past year, about "how often did you drink alcohol"?
fields.description_en: 1: Less than once a month, 2: 1-2 times a month, 3: Once a week, 4: Once every two or three days, 5: (Almost) every day

fields.name_zh: 【訪員查核】E7i 題目需由樣本個案本人回答，請確認受訪者是否為樣本個案本人：
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer check] Question E7i must be answered by the sampled case himself/herself. Please confirm whether the respondent is the sampled case himself/herself:

fields.name_zh: 跟一般人比起來，你覺得您自己是一個適量的飲酒者嗎？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Compared with other people, do you consider yourself a moderate drinker? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 您的親人及朋友認為您是一個適量的飲酒者嗎？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Do your relatives and friends consider you a moderate drinker? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因為喝酒的關係而失去朋友或者男朋友/女朋友？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever lost friends or a boyfriend/girlfriend because of drinking? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因喝酒而導致工作上產生問題或麻煩？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever had problems or trouble at work because of drinking? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因喝酒而忽略了您應盡的義務、您的家庭，或者您的工作，且超過兩天以上？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever neglected your obligations, your family, or your work for more than two days because of drinking? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因喝酒的問題，而向他人尋求協助？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever sought help from others because of a drinking problem? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾參與戒酒的治療團體或匿名戒酒團體？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever taken part in an alcohol treatment group or Alcoholics Anonymous? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因酒後(醉)駕車而遭警察開單或逮捕？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever been ticketed or arrested by the police for drunk driving? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因喝酒而住院？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever been hospitalized because of drinking? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾在喝很多酒後出現嚴重顫抖、精神錯亂、聽到聲音，或者看到一些並不存在的東西？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: After drinking a lot, have you ever had severe tremors, confusion, heard voices, or seen things that were not there? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 對您來說，拿到酒類飲料是一件容易的事嗎?
fields.description_zh: 1：非常困難、2：有點難、3：容易、4：非常容易
fields.name_zh_en: For you, is it easy to obtain alcoholic beverages?
fields.description_en: 1: Very difficult, 2: Somewhat difficult, 3: Easy, 4: Very easy

fields.name_zh: 在"過去十二個月"，您曾經有自己去買過酒嗎（包括各種酒類、保力達B、維士比與藥酒，與煮菜時加進去的酒，"所有的酒都算"）？
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past twelve months", have you personally bought alcohol (including all kinds of alcoholic drinks, Paolyta B, Vita Bee, and medicinal wine, and cooking wine added while cooking — "all alcohol counts")?

fields.name_zh: 您"過去十二個月"期間您自己去買酒時，是否有人檢查您的身分證明(如身分證或健保卡)？
fields.name_zh_en: In "the past twelve months", when you went to buy alcohol yourself, did anyone check your identification (such as an ID card or NHI card)?

fields.name_zh: 從以前到現在為止，請問您是否曾吸菸？（若有）總共有超過五包（約100支）嗎？
fields.description_zh: 0：從未吸過菸、1：曾吸菸，但未超過5包、2：曾吸菸，而且超過5包
fields.name_zh_en: Up to now, have you ever smoked? (If yes) Have you smoked more than five packs (about 100 cigarettes) in total?
fields.description_en: 0: Never smoked, 1: Has smoked, but not more than 5 packs, 2: Has smoked, and more than 5 packs

fields.name_zh: 請問您現在是每天吸菸、有時候吸菸還是都不吸菸呢？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you currently smoke every day, sometimes, or not at all?
fields.description_en: 1: Smokes every day, 2: Smokes sometimes, 3: Does not smoke

fields.name_zh: 在過去一個月內（30 天內），平均一天吸幾根菸？（一包菸20支）
fields.name_zh_en: In the past month (30 days), on average how many cigarettes did you smoke per day? (One pack = 20 cigarettes)

fields.name_zh: 在過去一個月內（30 天內），請問您大約有幾天吸菸呢？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past month (30 days), on approximately how many days did you smoke?

fields.name_zh: 在過去一個月內（30 天內），請問您有吸菸的日子中，平均一天吸幾根菸？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past month (within 30 days), on the days you smoked, how many cigarettes did you smoke per day on average?

fields.name_zh: 請問您幾歲開始有"吸菸的習慣"？【會主動想吸菸】"【以前有吸菸習慣的人也要問】"
fields.name_zh_en: At what age did you start the "habit of smoking"? [Feel the urge to smoke] "[Also ask those who used to smoke]"
fields.description_en: 0: No smoking habit, 1: Has smoking habit

fields.name_zh: 請問是幾足歲開始有"吸菸的習慣"？
fields.name_zh_en: At how many full years of age did you "start the habit of smoking"?

fields.name_zh: 在過去十二個月（一年）內，請問您有沒有因為想戒菸而停止吸菸一天或一天以上？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past twelve months (one year), did you stop smoking for one day or more because you wanted to quit smoking?
fields.description_en: 0: No, 1: Yes, 2: Quit smoking for more than one year

fields.name_zh: "過去一星期內"，有沒有人在您的面前吸菸？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week", has anyone smoked in front of you?

fields.name_zh: "過去一星期內"，您在"家裡"的時候，有沒有人在您的面前吸菸？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week", did anyone smoke in front of you when you were "at home"?
fields.description_en: 0: No, 1: Yes, 2: Was not at home in the past week

fields.name_zh: "過去一星期內"，您在"親友住處"的時候，有沒有人在您的面前吸菸？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week", did anyone smoke in front of you when you were at the "home of relatives or friends"?
fields.description_en: 0: No, 1: Yes, 2: Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: "過去一星期內"，您在"學校"的時候，有沒有人在您的面前吸菸？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," while you were at "school," did anyone smoke in your presence?
fields.description_en: 0: No, 1: Yes, 2: Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: "過去一星期內"，您在"您的室內工作場所或辦公室"的時候，有沒有人在您的面前吸菸？
fields.description_zh: 0：沒有、1：有、2：沒有工作或工作場所沒有室內區域
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," while you were at "your indoor workplace or office," did anyone smoke in your presence?
fields.description_en: 0: No, 1: Yes, 2: Not working or the workplace has no indoor area

fields.name_zh: "過去一星期內"，您在"其他室內公共場所"的時候，有沒有人在您的面前吸菸？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," while you were in "other indoor public places," did anyone smoke in your presence?
fields.description_en: 0: No, 1: Yes, 2: Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: "過去一星期內"，您在"其他室外公共場所"的時候，有沒有人在您的面前吸菸？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," while you were in "other outdoor public places," did anyone smoke in your presence?
fields.description_en: 0: No, 1: Yes, 2: Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: "過去一星期內有幾天"，有人在您的面前吸菸？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week, on how many days" did someone smoke in front of you?

fields.name_zh: 家人
fields.name_zh_en: family member

fields.name_zh: 朋友
fields.name_zh_en: friend

fields.name_zh: 親戚
fields.name_zh_en: relative

fields.name_zh: 鄰居
fields.name_zh_en: neighbor

fields.name_zh: 同事
fields.name_zh_en: colleague

fields.name_zh: 其他
fields.name_zh_en: Other

fields.name_zh: 您是否"曾經"嚼食過檳榔？【若有】請問是只吃過一兩次還是更多次？"【若更多次】"請問最近6個月內有沒有嚼？

fields.name_zh: 同儕以外其他非親戚

fields.name_zh: "目前包含您在內"，和您住在一起的總共有幾個人？
fields.name_zh_en: "Currently including you", how many people in total live with you?

fields.name_zh: 請問您目前的婚姻狀況是未婚、已婚，先生/太太也同住或是其他什麼樣的情況？
fields.description_zh:
0：從未結婚、1：已婚，目前與配偶同住(指一年中 6 個月以上時間同住)、2：已婚，現在未經常與配偶同住(指一年中同住時間少於6個月) 、3：目前已(正式)分居、
4：離婚(未再婚)、5：喪偶(未再婚)、6：其他
fields.name_zh_en: What is your current marital status: unmarried, married with husband/wife also living with you, or some other situation?
fields.description_en:
0: Never married, 1: Married, currently living with spouse (living together for 6 months or more in a year), 2: Married, not currently living regularly with spouse (living together for less than 6 months in a year), 3: Currently (legally) separated,
4: Divorced (not remarried), 5: Widowed (not remarried), 6: Other

fields.name_zh: 請問您的先生/太太籍貫是本省閩南人(河洛人)、客家人、大陸省份，還是哪裡人？
fields.description_zh:
1：本省閩南人(河洛人)、2：本省客家人、3：大陸省份(外省人)、4：中國大陸配偶、5：原住民、6：金門、馬祖、7：越南籍、8：泰國籍、9：印尼籍、10：菲律賓籍、
11：其他國籍
fields.name_zh_en: What is your husband's/wife's ancestral origin: native-province Hoklo (Minnan; Holo), Hakka, a mainland province, or elsewhere?
fields.description_en:
1: Taiwanese Hoklo (Holo), 2: Taiwanese Hakka, 3: Mainland provinces (mainlander), 4: Spouse from mainland China, 5: Indigenous, 6: Kinmen, Matsu, 7: Vietnamese nationality, 8: Thai nationality, 9: Indonesian nationality, 10: Philippine nationality,
11: Other nationality

fields.name_zh: 您先生/太太的年齡多大？滿_____足歲（實足年齡）
fields.name_zh_en: How old is your husband/wife? _____ full years (completed age)

fields.name_zh: "您先生/太太的最高學歷是什麼？
fields.description_zh: 詳見「教育程度代碼」譯碼說明
fields.name_zh_en: "What is your husband's/wife's highest educational level?

11：其他國籍
fields.name_zh_en: Is your "father" a native-province Hoklo (Minnan; Holo), Hakka, from a mainland province, or from elsewhere?
fields.description_en:
1: Taiwanese Hoklo (Holo), 2: Taiwanese Hakka, 3: Mainland provinces (mainlander), 4: Spouse from mainland China, 5: Indigenous, 6: Kinmen, Matsu, 7: Vietnamese nationality, 8: Thai nationality, 9: Indonesian nationality, 10: Philippine nationality,
11: Other nationality

fields.name_zh: 您的"母親"是本省閩南人(河洛人)、客家人、大陸省份，還是哪裡人？
fields.description_zh:
1：本省閩南人(河洛人)、2：本省客家人、3：大陸省份(外省人)、4：中國大陸配偶、5：原住民、6：金門、馬祖、7：越南籍、8：泰國籍、9：印尼籍、10：菲律賓籍、
11：其他國籍
fields.name_zh_en: Is your "mother" a native-province Hoklo (Minnan; Holo), Hakka, from a mainland province, or from elsewhere?
fields.description_en:
1: Taiwanese Hoklo (Holo), 2: Taiwanese Hakka, 3: Mainland provinces (mainlander), 4: Spouse from mainland China, 5: Indigenous, 6: Kinmen, Matsu, 7: Vietnamese nationality, 8: Thai nationality, 9: Indonesian nationality, 10: Philippine nationality,
11: Other nationality

fields.name_zh: 請問您信仰什麼宗教(信什麼教)？
fields.description_zh:
0：沒有信任何宗教、1：道教或民間傳統宗教信仰、2：佛教、3：基督教、4：天主教、5：一貫道、
6：回教、7：其他宗教
fields.name_zh_en: What religion do you believe in (which religion)?
fields.description_en:
0: No religion, 1: Taoism or folk traditional religion, 2: Buddhism, 3: Protestantism, 4: Catholicism, 5: I-Kuan Tao,
6: Islam, 7: Other religion

fields.name_zh: 【下面我提到的活動，請告訴我，平時您大約多常做這項活動？】您平時大約是多常在家裡禱告、燒香拜神或拜佛？
fields.name_zh_en: [For the activities I mention below, please tell me roughly how often you usually do this activity] How often do you usually pray, burn incense to worship gods, or worship Buddha at home?

fields.name_zh: 您平時大約是多常唸經或是讀(聖)經？
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you usually chant scriptures or read the (holy) scriptures?

fields.name_zh: 您平時大約是多常上教堂、佛堂或到寺廟裡拜拜？
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you usually go to church, Buddhist hall or temple to worship?

fields.name_zh: 您平時大約是多常看或聽宗教節目？
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you usually watch or listen to religious programs?

fields.name_zh: 【訪員查核】B1a~B1e 題目需由樣本個案本人回答，請確認受訪者是否為樣本個案本人：
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer check] Questions B1a-B1e must be answered by the sampled case himself/herself. Please confirm whether the respondent is the sampled case himself/herself:

fields.name_zh: 一般來說，您認為您"目前"的健康狀況是？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: In general, how would you rate your "current" health? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]
fields.description_en: 1: Very good, 2: Good, 3: Fair, 4: Poor, 5: Very poor

fields.name_zh: "和一年前"比較，您看您"目前"的健康狀況是？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 1：好很多、2：好一些、3：差不多、4：差一些、5：差很多
fields.name_zh_en: "Compared with one year ago", how would you rate your "current" health? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]
fields.description_en: 1: Much better, 2: Somewhat better, 3: About the same, 4: Somewhat worse, 5: Much worse

fields.name_zh: 您覺得您本身的健康情形，和身邊年紀差不多的人比起來是？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 1：比別人好很多、2：比別人好一些、3：和別人差不多、4：比別人差一些、5：比別人差很多
fields.name_zh_en: How do you consider your own health compared with people of about your age around you? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]
fields.description_en: 1: Much better than others, 2: Somewhat better than others, 3: About the same as others, 4: Somewhat worse than others, 5: Much worse than others

fields.name_zh: "過去一個月"，您有沒有愈來愈疲勞、無力的感覺？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past month", have you felt increasingly tired and weak? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: "過去一個月"，您有沒有身體愈來愈衰弱的感覺？【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past month", have you felt yourself getting weaker and weaker? [This question is for the person only; if not the person, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 請問您"現在"是否有因健康問題而造成日常活動受到限制，並且已經超過6個月以上？若有，此限制有多嚴重？
fields.description_zh: 0：沒有健康問題、1：有健康問題，但沒有受到限制、2：有受到限制，但不嚴重、3：受到嚴重的限制
fields.name_zh_en: Do you currently have limitations in daily activities due to a health problem that has lasted more than 6 months? If so, how severe is this limitation?
fields.description_en: 0: No health problem, 1: Has a health problem but not limited, 2: Limited but not seriously, 3: Seriously limited

fields.name_zh: 您有任何"已經持續了 6個月以上，或預期將會持續 6個月以上"的"慢性"疾病或健康問題嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have any "chronic" disease or health problem that "has lasted 6 months or more, or is expected to last 6 months or more"?

fields.name_zh: 【訪員查核】請問B2b 題(上一題)是由誰回答？
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer check] Who answered question B2b (the previous question)?

fields.name_zh: 您是不是"曾經"患有高血壓？【不包括懷孕時發生但產後痊癒的高血壓】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you "ever" had hypertension? [Excluding hypertension that occurred during pregnancy but resolved after delivery]

fields.name_zh: 是不是醫護人員告訴您的？
fields.name_zh_en: Were you told by a medical professional?

fields.name_zh: "目前醫師"是否有開降血壓的藥給您服用？
fields.name_zh_en: Has your "current doctor" prescribed you blood-pressure-lowering medication?

fields.name_zh: 您現在有沒有在服用"醫師處方"的降血壓藥？
fields.description_zh:
0：沒有、1：偶爾或必要時服用、
2：經常或按時服用
fields.name_zh_en: Are you currently taking "doctor-prescribed" blood pressure-lowering medication?
fields.description_en:
0: No, 1: Occasional or as-needed use,
2: Frequent or regular use

fields.name_zh: 您是否"曾經"患有糖尿病呢？【不包括懷孕時發生但產後痊癒的糖尿病】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you "ever" had diabetes? [Excluding diabetes that occurred during pregnancy but resolved after delivery]

fields.name_zh: 是不是醫護人員告訴您的？
fields.name_zh_en: Were you told by a medical professional?

fields.name_zh: 您是在滿幾歲時知道您有糖尿病的？_____足歲時
fields.name_zh_en: At what age did you learn that you have diabetes? At _____ full years of age

fields.name_zh: "目前"是否有使用"醫師開給您"的糖尿病藥物？
fields.name_zh_en: Are you "currently" using diabetes medication "prescribed by a doctor"?

fields.name_zh: 注射胰島素
fields.name_zh_en: insulin injection

fields.name_zh: 口服降血糖的藥物
fields.name_zh_en: oral hypoglycemic drugs

fields.name_zh: 您平均多久做一次"抽血(驗血糖)"檢查？
fields.description_zh: 1：至少每月 1 次、2：至少 3 個月一次、3：至少半年 1 次、4：至少1年1 次、5：不定期
fields.name_zh_en: On average, how often do you have "blood drawn (blood sugar test)"?
fields.description_en: 1: At least once a month, 2: At least once every 3 months, 3: At least once every six months, 4: At least once a year, 5: Irregularly

fields.name_zh: "最近一年內"，您有沒有"因為糖尿病特別去做"眼底(視網膜)檢查？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year", have you had a fundus (retina) examination "specifically because of diabetes"?

fields.name_zh: "最近一年內"，您有沒有"因為糖尿病特別去驗尿做腎功能"的檢查？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year", have you had a urine test for kidney function "specifically because of diabetes"?

fields.name_zh: 是否有檢查微量白蛋白？
fields.description_zh: 0：沒有驗微量白蛋白、1：有驗微量白蛋白
fields.name_zh_en: Was microalbumin checked?

fields.name_zh: "最近一年內"，您有沒有"因為糖尿病特別去做糖化血色素檢查(三個月的平均血糖檢查)"？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year", have you had "a glycated hemoglobin test specifically because of diabetes (a test of average blood glucose over three months)"?

fields.name_zh: 您有沒有"因為要控制糖尿病，自我驗血糖"？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you "self-test blood glucose in order to control diabetes"?

fields.name_zh: 您平均幾天做1次"血糖"自我檢查？
fields.description_zh: 1：每天/一天好幾次、2：2~3 天才 1 次、3：4~6 天才 1 次、4：1個星期或超過 1星期才1次
fields.name_zh_en: On average, how many days apart do you self-test "blood glucose"?
fields.description_en: 1: Every day/several times a day, 2: Once every 2-3 days, 3: Once every 4-6 days, 4: Once a week or less often

fields.name_zh: 您有沒有因為要預防糖尿病的併發症，注意自己的足部保養？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you taken care of your feet to prevent complications of diabetes?

fields.name_zh: 每天檢查雙腳
fields.name_zh_en: foot examination daily

fields.name_zh: 不要赤腳走路
fields.name_zh_en: Do not walk barefoot

fields.name_zh: 鞋頭要寬
fields.name_zh_en: shoe toe width

fields.name_zh: 指甲要修剪，不可短於指頭邊緣線
fields.name_zh_en: Nails should be trimmed, not shorter than the edge of the fingertip

fields.name_zh: 不要用刀片割雞眼(硬肉)
fields.name_zh_en: Do not cut corns (hard flesh) with a blade

fields.name_zh: 保持腳的清潔及乾燥
fields.name_zh_en: Keep feet clean and dry

fields.name_zh: 穿棉質襪
fields.name_zh_en: Wear cotton socks

fields.name_zh: 其他保養方法
fields.name_zh_en: other care methods

fields.name_zh: 您是不是"曾經"有過"血液脂肪"(血油)"過高"(即膽固醇或三酸甘油脂過高)的問題呢？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you "ever" had a problem of "high blood fats" (blood lipids) (i.e., high cholesterol or triglycerides)?

fields.name_zh: 是不是醫護人員(含醫檢師)告訴您的？
fields.name_zh_en: Was it told to you by medical personnel (including medical technologists)?

fields.name_zh: "目前"醫師是否有開降血脂(降血油)的藥給您服用？
fields.name_zh_en: "Currently", has a doctor prescribed lipid-lowering (blood fat-lowering) medication for you to take?

fields.name_zh: 您"現在"有沒有在服用"醫師處方"降血脂(降血油)的藥？
fields.description_zh:
0：沒有、1：偶爾或必要時服用、
2：經常或按時服用
fields.name_zh_en: Are you "currently" taking "physician-prescribed" lipid-lowering medication?
fields.description_en:
0: No, 1: Occasional or as-needed use,
2: Frequent or regular use

fields.name_zh: 從上面您所告訴我的，您說您有"三高疾病"(高血壓、糖尿病或高血脂)，請問除了吃藥之外，在日常生活上，您有沒有"量血壓"？(若有)多久量一次？
fields.description_zh:
1：(幾乎)沒有、2：至少每年 1次、
3：至少半年 1 次、4：至少三個月1次、5：至少每個月 1 次、6：每月 2-3 次、7：每週 1-2 次、8：幾乎每天量
fields.name_zh_en: From what you have told me, you said you have the "three highs" (hypertension, diabetes, or hyperlipidemia). Besides taking medication, in daily life do you "measure your blood pressure"? (If so) How often?
fields.description_en:
1: (Almost) never, 2: At least once a year,
3: At least once every 6 months, 4: At least once every 3 months, 5: At least once a month, 6: 2-3 times a month, 7: 1-2 times a week, 8: Almost every day

fields.name_zh: 請問除了吃藥之外，在日常生活上，您有沒有"量血糖"？(若有)多久量一次？
fields.description_zh:
1：(幾乎)沒有、2：至少每年 1次、
3：至少半年 1 次、4：至少三個月1次、5：至少每個月 1 次、6：每月 2-3 次、7：每週 1-2 次、8：幾乎每天量
fields.name_zh_en: Apart from taking medication, do you "measure your blood glucose" in daily life? (If yes) How often?
fields.description_en:
1: (Almost) never, 2: At least once a year,
3: At least once every 6 months, 4: At least once every 3 months, 5: At least once a month, 6: 2-3 times a month, 7: 1-2 times a week, 8: Almost every day

fields.name_zh: 請問除了吃藥之外，在日常生活上，您有沒有"量血脂"？(若有)多久量一次？
fields.description_zh:
1：(幾乎)沒有、2：至少每年 1次、
3：至少半年 1 次、4：至少三個月1次、5：至少每個月 1 次、6：每月 2-3 次、7：每週 1-2 次、8：幾乎每天量
fields.name_zh_en: Apart from taking medication, do you "measure your blood lipids" in daily life? (If yes) How often?
fields.description_en:
1: (Almost) never, 2: At least once a year,
3: At least once every 6 months, 4: At least once every 3 months, 5: At least once a month, 6: 2-3 times a month, 7: 1-2 times a week, 8: Almost every day

fields.name_zh: 控制體重
fields.name_zh_en: Weight control

fields.name_zh: 少吸菸
fields.name_zh_en: less smoking

fields.name_zh: 少飲酒
fields.name_zh_en: less drinking

fields.name_zh: 養成運動習慣
fields.name_zh_en: developing exercise habits

fields.name_zh: 飲食控制(避免動物性脂肪與高膽固醇食物、多吃高纖維食物、少量多餐、少油少鹽等)
fields.name_zh_en: Dietary control (avoiding animal fat and high-cholesterol foods, eating more high-fiber foods, eating smaller and more frequent meals, less oil and salt, etc.)

fields.name_zh: 生活規律、避免熬夜、放鬆壓力等生活調適
fields.name_zh_en: Maintain a regular routine, avoid staying up late, relax and reduce stress, and other lifestyle adjustments

fields.name_zh: 打坐、太極、氣功等
fields.name_zh_en: Meditation, tai chi, qigong, etc.

fields.name_zh: 其他控制方法
fields.name_zh_en: other control methods

fields.name_zh: 以上都沒有
fields.name_zh_en: None of the above

fields.name_zh: 您是不是"曾經"有發生過"中風"(腦溢血或腦血栓)的情形？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you "ever" had a "stroke" (cerebral hemorrhage or cerebral thrombosis)?

fields.name_zh: 您"曾經"有發生過幾次"中風"？共______次
fields.name_zh_en: How many times have you "ever" had a "stroke"? ______ times in total

fields.name_zh: 您"那(第)一次"發生中風時，是不是醫護人員告訴您的？
fields.name_zh_en: When you had your "first" stroke, was it a health care professional who told you?

fields.name_zh: 您知道那(第)一次中風發生的年/月份嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you know the year/month in which "that (first)" stroke occurred?

fields.name_zh: 您是什麼時候發生"那(第)一次"中風的？民國_____年
fields.name_zh_en: When did your "first" stroke occur? ROC year _____

fields.name_zh: 您是什麼時候發生"那(第)一次"中風的？_____月
fields.name_zh_en: When did your "first" stroke occur? Month _____

fields.name_zh: 您是什麼時候發生"那(第)一次"中風的？_____年前
fields.name_zh_en: When did your "first" stroke occur? _____ years ago

fields.name_zh: "那(第)一次"發生時，有沒有送醫？
fields.name_zh_en: When "that (first) incident" occurred, were you taken to the hospital?

fields.name_zh: 突如其來單側肢體的虛弱或麻木
fields.name_zh_en: Sudden weakness or numbness on one side of the body

fields.name_zh: 理解語言或運用文字有困難
fields.name_zh_en: Has difficulty understanding language or using written text

fields.name_zh: 劇烈頭痛
fields.name_zh_en: severe headache

fields.name_zh: 失去平衡
fields.name_zh_en: loss of balance

fields.name_zh: 眩暈
fields.name_zh_en: Vertigo

fields.name_zh: 出現視力問題
fields.name_zh_en: Developed vision problems

fields.name_zh: 其他徵兆
fields.name_zh_en: other signs

fields.name_zh: 您是不是"曾經"發生過"短暫性"的"手腳麻痺或無力"、"眼睛突然看不見或看不清楚"、"說話不清"，而在24小時內就恢復的現象？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you "ever" had "transient" "numbness or weakness of the hands or feet", "sudden loss of vision or blurred vision in the eyes", or "slurred speech" that resolved within 24 hours?

fields.name_zh: 您有沒有因為這樣去做檢查？
fields.name_zh_en: Did you get examined because of this?

fields.name_zh: 您是否"曾經"被醫師診斷有氣喘病？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you "ever" been diagnosed with asthma by a doctor?

fields.name_zh: "第一次"醫師診斷您有氣喘病時，當時您是幾歲？
fields.description_zh: 1：10 歲及 10 歲以下、2：11 歲及11 歲以上
fields.name_zh_en: At what age were you when a physician diagnosed you with asthma for the "first time"?
fields.description_en: 1: Aged 10 or under, 2: Aged 11 or over

fields.name_zh_en: "Without" using any assistive device or help, would you have difficulty walking 500 meters on level ground (about two and a half laps of an elementary school track or five blocks)?

fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Considerable difficulty, 4: Cannot do at all

fields.description_zh: 1：沒有困難、2：有點困難、3：相當困難、4：完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: "With" the use of any assistive devices or help, do you have difficulty walking 100 meters on level ground (about half a lap of an elementary school track or the distance of one block)?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Considerable difficulty, 4: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 在"有使用"任何輔具、或幫助的情形下，您在平地上走 500公尺(大約是小學操場兩圈半或五個街口的距離)會有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1：沒有困難、2：有點困難、3：相當困難、4：完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: "With" the use of any assistive devices or help, do you have difficulty walking 500 meters on level ground (about two and a half laps of an elementary school track or the distance of five blocks)?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Considerable difficulty, 4: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 當您使用慣用的語言與別人溝通時，是否會有困難，例如：您了解別人說的或別人也了解您說的？
fields.description_zh: 1：沒有困難、2：有點困難、3：相當困難、4：完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: When you communicate with others in your usual language, do you have any difficulty — for example, understanding what others say or having others understand what you say?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Considerable difficulty, 4: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 您是否使用手語？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you use sign language?

fields.name_zh: 請問您是否有記憶力上的困難或覺得沒有辦法專心？
fields.description_zh: 1：沒有困難、2：有點困難、3：相當困難、4：完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have any memory difficulties or feel unable to concentrate?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Considerable difficulty, 4: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 請問您是有記憶上的困難，還是沒有辦法專心，或是兩者都有困難呢？
fields.description_zh: 1：有記憶上的困難、2：難以專心、3：記憶、專注力都有困難
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty with memory, or trouble concentrating, or both?
fields.description_en: 1: Difficulty with memory, 2: Difficulty concentrating, 3: Difficulty with both memory and concentration

fields.name_zh: 請問您多常有記憶力上的困難？是有時有？經常有？或是總是有困難？
fields.description_zh:
1：有時有困難、2：經常有困難、
3：總是有困難
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you have difficulty with memory? Sometimes? Often? Or always?
fields.description_en:
1: Sometimes difficult, 2: Often difficult,
3: Always difficult

fields.name_zh: 請問您是在少數事情、許多事情、或是幾乎所有事情上都有記憶上的困難？
fields.description_zh: 1：少數事情、2：許多事情、3：幾乎所有事情
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have memory difficulties in a few things, many things, or almost everything?
fields.description_en: 1: A few things, 2: Many things, 3: Almost everything

fields.name_zh: 請問您在自我照顧上有困難嗎，例如吃飯、穿脫衣服、站立、室內走動、上廁所、洗澡？
fields.description_zh: 1：沒有困難、2：有點困難、3：相當困難、4：完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty with self-care, such as eating, dressing/undressing, standing, walking indoors, using the toilet, bathing?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Considerable difficulty, 4: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 請問您把一個裝滿2公升水的瓶子從腰間舉到眼睛高度會有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1：沒有困難、2：有點困難、3：相當困難、4：完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty lifting a 2-liter bottle full of water from waist to eye level?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Considerable difficulty, 4: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 請問您使用手及手指有困難嗎？例如拿起小東西(像是一個鈕扣或鉛筆之類的)，或是打開、旋上容器與瓶子。
fields.description_zh: 1：沒有困難、2：有點困難、3：相當困難、4：完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty using your hands and fingers? For example, picking up small objects (such as a button or pencil), or opening and closing containers and bottles.
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Considerable difficulty, 4: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 請問您多常會感到擔心、緊張或焦慮？
fields.description_zh: 1：每天、2：每週、3：每月、4：一年中有幾次、5：從來沒有
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you feel worried, nervous or anxious?
fields.description_en: 1: Every day, 2: Every week, 3: Every month, 4: A few times a year, 5: Never

fields.name_zh: 請問您有因為擔心、緊張或焦慮等情緒而服用藥物嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you take medication because of feelings such as worry, nervousness or anxiety?

fields.name_zh: 請問您有因為擔心、緊張或焦慮等情緒而服用藥物嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you take medication because of feelings such as worry, nervousness or anxiety?

fields.name_zh: 請您回想最近一次感到擔心、緊張或焦慮的情形，當時這些感覺有多強烈？
fields.description_zh: 1：有點擔心、緊張或焦慮、2：非常擔心、緊張或焦慮、3：介於有點與非常之間
fields.name_zh_en: Think back to the most recent time you felt worried, tense or anxious. How intense were these feelings at the time?
fields.description_en: 1: Somewhat worried, tense or anxious, 2: Very worried, tense or anxious, 3: Between somewhat and very

fields.name_zh: 請問您多常會感到憂鬱、沮喪？
fields.description_zh: 1：每天、2：每週、3：每月、4：一年中有幾次、5：從來沒有
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you feel depressed or dejected?
fields.description_en: 1: Every day, 2: Every week, 3: Every month, 4: A few times a year, 5: Never

fields.name_zh_en: Do you take medication because of depression or dejection?

fields.name_zh: 請問您有因為憂鬱、沮喪而服用藥物嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you take medication because of depression or dejection?

fields.name_zh: 請您回想最近一次感到憂鬱、沮喪的情形，當時的感覺有多強？
fields.description_zh: 1：有點憂鬱、沮喪、2：非常憂鬱、沮喪、3：介於有點與非常之間
fields.name_zh_en: Think back to the most recent time you felt depressed or dejected. How strong was the feeling at the time?
fields.description_en: 1: Somewhat depressed or dejected, 2: Very depressed or dejected, 3: Between somewhat and very

fields.name_zh: 在過去三個月內，請問您多常感到疼痛？
fields.description_zh: 1：從來沒有、2：有時候有、3：多數日子有、4：每天都有
fields.name_zh_en: In the past three months, how often have you felt pain?
fields.description_en: 1: Never, 2: Sometimes, 3: Most days, 4: Every day

fields.name_zh: 請您回想最近一次感到疼痛的情形，當時感到疼痛的程度有多嚴重？
fields.description_zh: 1：有點痛、2：非常痛、3：介於有點與非常之間
fields.name_zh_en: Think back to the most recent time you felt pain. How severe was the pain at the time?
fields.description_en: 1: Somewhat painful, 2: Very painful, 3: Between somewhat and very

fields.name_zh: 在過去三個月內，請問您多常感到非常疲倦或精疲力盡？
fields.description_zh: 1：從來沒有、2：有時候有、3：多數日子有、4：每天都有
fields.name_zh_en: In the past three months, how often have you felt very tired or exhausted?
fields.description_en: 1: Never, 2: Sometimes, 3: Most days, 4: Every day

fields.name_zh: 請您回想最近一次感到非常疲倦或精疲力盡時的情形，當時它持續了多久？
fields.description_zh: 1：一天中的部份時間、2：一天中的多數時間、3：整天
fields.name_zh_en: Think back to the most recent time you felt very tired or exhausted. How long did it last?
fields.description_en: 1: Part of the day, 2: Most of the day, 3: All day

fields.name_zh: 請您回想最近一次感到疲倦時的情形，您覺得當時感到疲倦的程度是如何？

7：拖曳車、8：產業用交通工具、
9：其他

fields.description_en:
1: Car, 2: Minibus, van, 3: Bus, 4: Large bus, boat, or 18-wheeler large transport vehicle, 5: Motorcycle, 6: Jeep, crossover SUV, or snowmobile,
7: Tow vehicle, 8: Industrial vehicle,
9: Other

6: 20 to 29 days, 7: The whole month

3：超過一個月至半年內、4：超過半年至一年內、5：超過一年以上
fields.name_zh_en: When did you "last get drunk"?
fields.description_en:
0: Never drunk, 1: Within the last 7 days, 2: More than 1 week to 1 month ago,
3: More than 1 month to 6 months ago, 4: More than 6 months to 1 year ago, 5: More than 1 year ago

fields.description_en: 1: Less than once a month, 2: 1-2 times a month, 3: Once a week, 4: Once every two or three days, 5: (Almost) every day

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因為喝酒的關係而失去朋友或者男朋友/女朋友？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever lost friends or a boyfriend/girlfriend because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因喝酒而導致工作上產生問題或麻煩？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever had problems or trouble at work because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因喝酒而忽略了您應盡的義務、您的家庭，或者您的工作，且超過兩天以上？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever neglected your obligations, your family, or your work for more than two days because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因喝酒的問題，而向他人尋求協助？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever sought help from others because of a drinking problem?

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾參與戒酒的治療團體或匿名戒酒團體？

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因酒後(醉)駕車而遭警察開單或逮捕？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever been ticketed or arrested by the police for driving after drinking (drunk driving)?

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因喝酒而住院？

fields.name_zh: 請問您平日一天坐著的時間共幾小時？
fields.name_zh_en: How many hours in total do you sit on an ordinary weekday?

fields.name_zh: 請問您假日一天坐著的時間共幾小時？
fields.name_zh_en: How many hours in total do you sit on a holiday/weekend day?

fields.name_zh: "在週間"(禮拜一到禮拜五)，您通常什麼時候起床？____時
fields.name_zh_en: "On weekdays" (Monday to Friday), what time do you usually get up? ____ o'clock

fields.name_zh: "在週間"(禮拜一到禮拜五)，您通常什麼時候起床？____分
fields.name_zh_en: "On weekdays" (Monday to Friday), what time do you usually get up? ____ minutes

fields.name_zh: "在週間"(禮拜一到禮拜五)，您通常什麼時候上床就寢？____時
fields.name_zh_en: "On weekdays" (Monday to Friday), what time do you usually go to bed? ____ o'clock

fields.name_zh: "在週間"(禮拜一到禮拜五)，您通常什麼時候上床就寢？____分
fields.name_zh_en: "On weekdays" (Monday to Friday), what time do you usually go to bed? ____ minutes

fields.name_zh: 您通常實際有睡著的時間大約多長？【不含午睡，以小時單位】
fields.name_zh_en: About how long do you usually actually sleep? [Excluding naps, in hours]

fields.name_zh: 您通常是否有睡午覺的習慣？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you usually have the habit of taking a nap?

fields.name_zh: 您通常午睡多久？____小時
fields.name_zh_en: How long do you usually nap? ____ hours

fields.name_zh: 您通常午睡多久？____分鐘
fields.name_zh_en: How long do you usually nap? ____ minutes

fields.name_zh: "過去一年裡"，您睡覺時是否會打鼾？
fields.description_zh:
1：從不、2：很少(一星期1~2次)、
3：有時(一星期 3~4次)、4：常常(一星期5次以上)
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past year", do you snore when sleeping?
fields.description_en:
1: Never, 2: Rarely (1-2 times a week),
3: Sometimes (3-4 times a week), 4: Often (5 or more times a week)

fields.name_zh: "過去一年裡"，您睡覺時是否會岔氣、喘不過氣、或呼吸暫時停止？
fields.description_zh:
1：從不、2：很少(一星期1~2次)、
3：有時(一星期 3~4次)、4：常常(一星期5次以上)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year", have you choked, gasped for breath, or temporarily stopped breathing during sleep?
fields.description_en:
1: Never, 2: Rarely (1-2 times a week),
3: Sometimes (3-4 times a week), 4: Often (5 or more times a week)

fields.name_zh: 請問您在"過去一個月內"，是否"有服用安眠藥幫助入睡"？
fields.name_zh_en: In "the past month", have you "taken sleeping pills to help you fall asleep"?
fields.description_en: 1: Never, 2: Rarely (less than once a month), 3: Sometimes (2~4 times a month), 4: Often (5~15 times a month), 5: Always (16~30 times a month)

fields.name_zh: 請問您在"過去一個月內"，是否有"睡不著的問題"？
fields.name_zh_en: In "the past month", have you had "trouble sleeping"?
fields.description_en: 1: Never, 2: Rarely (less than once a month), 3: Sometimes (2~4 times a month), 4: Often (5~15 times a month), 5: Always (16~30 times a month)

fields.name_zh: 請問您在"過去一個月內"，是否會"半夜醒來後再難以入睡"？
fields.name_zh_en: In "the past month", did you "wake up in the middle of the night and find it hard to fall back asleep"?
fields.description_en: 1: Never, 2: Rarely (less than once a month), 3: Sometimes (2~4 times a month), 4: Often (5~15 times a month), 5: Always (16~30 times a month)

fields.name_zh: 請問您在"過去一個月內"，是否會"太早醒來後沒辦法再繼續睡"？
fields.name_zh_en: In "the past month", did you "wake up too early and be unable to go back to sleep"?
fields.description_en: 1: Never, 2: Rarely (less than once a month), 3: Sometimes (2~4 times a month), 4: Often (5~15 times a month), 5: Always (16~30 times a month)

fields.name_zh: 請問您在"過去一個月內"，是否會"白天也覺得非常想睡覺"？
fields.name_zh_en: In "the past month", did you "feel very sleepy during the day"?
fields.description_en: 1: Never, 2: Rarely (less than once a month), 3: Sometimes (2~4 times a month), 4: Often (5~15 times a month), 5: Always (16~30 times a month)

fields.name_zh: 是否曾有"醫師診斷過"您有失眠的情形？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever been "diagnosed by a physician" with insomnia?

fields.name_zh: 公分
fields.name_zh_en: centimeter

fields.name_zh: 吋
fields.name_zh_en: hour

fields.name_zh: 【訪員填寫】這是口述還是實際測量的？
fields.name_zh_en: 【To be filled in by interviewer】Is this self-reported or actually measured?

fields.name_zh: 受訪者口述的腰圍數據，是依據：
fields.description_zh: 1：個案告知測量結果、2：個案告知衣物尺寸
fields.name_zh_en: The waist circumference data reported by the respondent are based on:
fields.description_en: 1: Case reported the measurement result, 2: Case reported the clothing size

fields.name_zh: 個案腰圍採實際測量，其測量方式為？
fields.name_zh_en: Waist circumference was actually measured; what was the measurement method?
fields.description_en: 1: Measured flat against the skin, 2: Measured over clothing

fields.name_zh: 您有沒有"固定量腰圍的習慣"？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have the "habit of regularly measuring your waist circumference"?

fields.name_zh: 您大概多久量一次腰圍？
fields.description_zh: 1：幾乎每個月量、2：1~3個月一次、3：4~6 個月一次、4：7~12個月量一次、5：超過 1年以上才量一次
fields.name_zh_en: About how often do you measure your waist circumference?
fields.description_en: 1: Measure almost every month, 2: Once every 1-3 months, 3: Once every 4-6 months, 4: Once every 7-12 months, 5: Once every more than 1 year

fields.name_zh: 請問您現在的身高是多少公分？
fields.name_zh_en: What is your current height in cm?

fields.name_zh: 請問您現在的體重是多少公斤？
fields.name_zh_en: What is your current weight in kg?

fields.name_zh: 【訪員填寫】個案的身高數據是口述還是實際測量的？
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer to fill in] Is the case's height data self-reported or actually measured?

fields.name_zh: 【訪員填寫】個案的體重數據是口述還是實際測量的？
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer to fill in] Is the case's weight data self-reported or actually measured?

fields.name_zh: 您大概多久量一次體重？
fields.description_zh:
1：幾乎每天量、2：幾乎每週量、
3：幾乎每月量、4：2~3 個月以上才量一次、5：很少量
fields.name_zh_en: About how often do you measure your weight?
fields.description_en:
1: Measure almost every day, 2: Measure almost every week,
3: Measure almost every month, 4: Measure once every 2-3 months or more, 5: Rarely measure

fields.name_zh: 您"現在"是否有在控制體重？（包括減輕體重、增加體重、維持現狀等）
fields.description_zh:
1：減輕體重、2：控制維持現狀、
3：增加體重、4：沒有做任何控制
fields.name_zh_en: Are you "currently" controlling your weight? (Including losing weight, gaining weight, maintaining current weight, etc.)
fields.description_en:
1: Lose weight, 2: Control to maintain the current weight,
3: Gain weight, 4: No weight control

fields.name_zh: 參加醫院或門診體重控制班
fields.name_zh_en: Attend a hospital or outpatient weight-control class

fields.name_zh: 參加私人體重控制班
fields.name_zh_en: Attend a private weight-control class

fields.name_zh: 使用偏方
fields.name_zh_en: alternative remedy

fields.name_zh: 多運動
fields.name_zh_en: more exercise

fields.name_zh: 減少熱量攝取
fields.name_zh_en: reduce heat intake

fields.name_zh: 跳過幾餐不吃
fields.name_zh_en: missed meals

fields.name_zh: 減少脂肪攝取
fields.name_zh_en: reduce fat intake

fields.name_zh: 減少或不吃肉類製品
fields.name_zh_en: Reduce or avoid eating meat products

fields.name_zh: 針灸
fields.name_zh_en: acupuncture

fields.name_zh: 埋針
fields.name_zh_en: injection

fields.name_zh: 使用市售減肥代餐包或減肥茶
fields.name_zh_en: Use commercially available meal-replacement packs or weight-loss tea

fields.name_zh: 飲食自我控制(多吃水果與蔬菜、或減少甜食與精緻食品、控制食量、戒掉宵夜)
fields.name_zh_en: Self-controlled diet (eating more fruits and vegetables, or reducing sweets and refined foods, controlling food intake, quitting late-night snacks)

fields.name_zh: 服用減肥藥
fields.name_zh_en: taking weight loss medication

fields.name_zh: 服用瀉藥
fields.name_zh_en: Laxative Use

fields.name_zh: 催吐
fields.name_zh_en: emesis

fields.name_zh: 禁食24小時或更久
fields.name_zh_en: Fasted for 24 hours or more

fields.name_zh: 其他方式
fields.name_zh_en: other means

fields.name_zh: 一般來說，您一星期內有幾天會吃到水果？
fields.name_zh_en: Generally speaking, how many days a week do you eat fruit?

fields.name_zh: 有吃水果的日子，您平均一天吃到多少份？(一份水果約 1個拳頭大小)
fields.name_zh_en: On days you eat fruit, how many servings do you eat per day on average? (1 serving of fruit is about the size of a fist)

fields.name_zh: 一般來說，您一星期內有幾天會吃到蔬菜？
fields.name_zh_en: Generally speaking, how many days a week do you eat vegetables?

fields.name_zh: 有吃蔬菜的日子，您平均一天吃到多少份？(煮熟蔬菜一份約1/2 飯碗、生鮮葉菜一份約1飯碗)
fields.name_zh_en: On days you eat vegetables, how many servings do you eat per day on average? (1 serving of cooked vegetables is about 1/2 a rice bowl, 1 serving of raw leafy greens is about 1 rice bowl)

fields.name_zh: 您平常有沒有幫忙打掃家裡？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you usually help clean the house?

fields.name_zh: 請問您多久和您的"子女"見一次面？
fields.description_zh: 1：從不見面、2：每天見面、3：每週至少 2~3 次、4：每週至少 1次、5：每月至少 1 次、6：很少見面、7：沒有子女、8：子女已過世
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you meet with your "children"?
fields.description_en: 1: Never meet, 2: Meet every day, 3: At least 2~3 times a week, 4: At least once a week, 5: At least once a month, 6: Rarely meet, 7: No children, 8: Children deceased

fields.name_zh: 請問您多久和您的"兄弟姊妹"見一次面？
fields.description_zh: 1：從不見面、2：每天見面、3：每週至少 2~3 次、4：每週至少 1次、5：每月至少 1 次、6：很少見面、7：沒有兄弟姊妹、8：兄弟姐妹已過世
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you meet with your "siblings"?
fields.description_en: 1: Never meet, 2: Meet every day, 3: At least 2~3 times a week, 4: At least once a week, 5: At least once a month, 6: Rarely meet, 7: No siblings, 8: Siblings deceased

fields.name_zh: 請問您多久和您的"其他親戚"見一次面？
fields.description_zh: 1：從不見面、2：每天見面、3：每週至少 2~3 次、4：每週至少 1次、5：每月至少 1 次、6：很少見面、7：沒有其他親戚、8：其他親戚已過世
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you meet with your "other relatives"?
fields.description_en: 1: Never meet, 2: Meet every day, 3: At least 2~3 times a week, 4: At least once a week, 5: At least once a month, 6: Rarely meet, 7: No other relatives, 8: Other relatives deceased

fields.name_zh: 請問您與"朋友"多久會"聯絡"(包括"見面、通電話或寫信")一次？
fields.description_zh: 1：從不聯絡、2：每天聯絡、3：每週至少聯絡 2~3 次、4：每週至少 1 次、5：每個月至少 1次 、6：很少聯絡、7：沒有朋友
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you "contact" "friends" (including "meeting, phone calls or letters")?
fields.description_en: 1: Never in contact, 2: Contact every day, 3: Contact at least 2-3 times a week, 4: At least once a week, 5: At least once a month, 6: Rarely in contact, 7: No friends

fields.name_zh: 請問您和鄰居多久會一起聊天、或您到他家或他到您家坐坐(要彼此有"聊天、互動"才算，只是碰面點頭打招呼不算)？
fields.description_zh: 1：從不來往、2：每天、3：每週至少 2~3 次、4：每週至少 1次、5：每個月至少 1 次 、6：很少、7：沒有鄰居
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you chat with neighbors, or visit their home or have them visit yours (there must be "chatting and interaction"; merely meeting and nodding a greeting does not count)?
fields.description_en: 1: No contact, 2: Every day, 3: At least 2-3 times a week, 4: At least once a week, 5: At least once a month, 6: Rarely, 7: No neighbors

fields.name_zh: 您"目前"有沒有在幫忙照顧小孩(包括子女、孫子女及當保母帶別人的小孩)？
fields.name_zh_en: Are you "currently" helping to take care of children (including your own children, grandchildren, and other people's children as a babysitter)?

fields.name_zh: 您"目前"有沒有在擔任義工或志工？
fields.name_zh_en: Are you "currently" serving as a volunteer?

fields.name_zh: 請問您有沒有參加任何宗教活動(例如進香團、參加教會活動、做禮拜等)？
fields.description_zh: 1：沒有、2：有，偶爾參加、3：有，定期參加
fields.name_zh_en: Do you take part in any religious activities (such as pilgrimage groups, church activities, attending worship services)?
fields.description_en: 1: No, 2: Yes, participates occasionally, 3: Yes, participates regularly

fields.name_zh: 請問您有沒有參加社區或鄰里的團體或活動，如老人會、村里民活動、康樂活動(如早覺會、土風舞、氣功社等)？
fields.description_zh: 1：沒有、2：有，偶爾參加、3：有，定期參加
fields.name_zh_en: Do you take part in any community or neighborhood groups or activities, such as senior associations, village/neighborhood activities, or recreational activities (such as morning exercise groups, folk dance, qigong clubs)?
fields.description_en: 1: No, 2: Yes, participates occasionally, 3: Yes, participates regularly

fields.name_zh: 【訪員查核】E節需樣本個案本人回答，請確認受訪者是否為樣本個案本人
fields.name_zh_en: 【Interviewer verification】Section E must be answered by the sample case themselves; please confirm whether the respondent is the sample case themselves

fields.name_zh: 在行動方面：
fields.description_zh: 1：我可以四處走動，沒有任何問題、2：我行動有些不便、3：我臥病在床
fields.name_zh_en: In terms of mobility:
fields.description_en: 1: I can move around without any problems, 2: I have some difficulty moving around, 3: I am bedridden

fields.name_zh: 在自我照顧方面：
fields.description_zh: 1：我能照顧自己，沒有任何問題、2：我在盥洗、洗澡或穿衣方面有些問題、3：我無法自己盥洗、洗澡或穿衣
fields.name_zh_en: In terms of self-care:
fields.description_en: 1: I can take care of myself without any problems, 2: I have some problems washing, bathing or dressing myself, 3: I am unable to wash, bathe or dress myself

fields.name_zh: 在平常活動(如工作、讀書、家事、家庭或休閒活動)方面：
fields.description_zh: 1：我能從事平常活動，沒有任何問題、2：我在從事平常活動方面有些問題、3：我無法從事平常活動
fields.name_zh_en: Regarding usual activities (such as work, study, housework, family or leisure activities):
fields.description_en: 1: I can do my usual activities without any problems, 2: I have some problems doing my usual activities, 3: I am unable to do my usual activities

fields.name_zh: 在疼痛/不舒服方面：
fields.description_zh: 1：我沒有任何疼痛或不舒服、2：我覺得中度疼痛或不舒服、3：我覺得極度疼痛或不舒服
fields.name_zh_en: In terms of pain/discomfort:
fields.description_en: 1: I have no pain or discomfort, 2: I have moderate pain or discomfort, 3: I have extreme pain or discomfort

fields.name_zh: 在焦慮/沮喪方面：
fields.description_zh: 1：我不覺得焦慮或沮喪、2：我覺得中度焦慮或沮喪、3：我覺得極度焦慮或沮喪
fields.name_zh_en: Regarding anxiety/depression:
fields.description_en: 1: I am not anxious or depressed, 2: I am moderately anxious or depressed, 3: I am extremely anxious or depressed

fields.name_zh: 100代表您想像中最好的狀況，0代表您想像中最差的狀況。請標出您今天健康狀況的好壞。
fields.name_zh_en: 100 represents the best state you can imagine, and 0 represents the worst state you can imagine. Please mark how good or bad your health is today.

fields.name_zh: 【訪員查核】F節及G 節題目需由樣本個案本人回答，請確認受訪者是否為樣本個案本人
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer check] Sections F and G must be answered by the sampled case himself/herself. Please confirm whether the respondent is the sampled case himself/herself.

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得不想吃東西、胃口不好？
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天)、1:有時候(1~2 天)、2:常常(3~4 天)、3:幾乎一直是(5~7 天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week", have you felt like not eating or had a poor appetite?
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得心情很不好、鬱悶？
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天)、1:有時候(1~2 天)、2:常常(3~4 天)、3:幾乎一直是(5~7 天)
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past week", did you feel in a very bad mood, depressed?
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得事情總是不太順利？
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天)、1:有時候(1~2 天)、2:常常(3~4 天)、3:幾乎一直是(5~7 天)
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past week", did you feel that things are always not going well?
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得睡不安穩(不入眠)？
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天)、1:有時候(1~2 天)、2:常常(3~4 天)、3:幾乎一直是(5~7 天)
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past week", did you feel your sleep was restless (unable to fall asleep)?
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得很快樂？
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天)、1:有時候(1~2 天)、2:常常(3~4 天)、3:幾乎一直是(5~7 天)
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past week", did you feel very happy?
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得寂寞、孤單？
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天)、1:有時候(1~2 天)、2:常常(3~4 天)、3:幾乎一直是(5~7 天)
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past week", did you feel lonely?
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得別人都不友善？
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天)、1:有時候(1~2 天)、2:常常(3~4 天)、3:幾乎一直是(5~7 天)
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past week", did you feel that others are unfriendly?
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得日子過的很好，享受人生？
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天)、1:有時候(1~2 天)、2:常常(3~4 天)、3:幾乎一直是(5~7 天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week", have you felt that life was going well and enjoyed life?
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得傷心、悲哀？

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得提不起勁來做任何事？
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天)、1:有時候(1~2 天)、2:常常(3~4 天)、3:幾乎一直是(5~7 天)

fields.name_zh_en: What is this? [pointing at a wristwatch]

1：有唸出來

fields.description_en:
0: Did not read aloud / read unclearly / read incorrectly,
1: Read aloud

fields.name_zh_en: Place on the floor (or table)

fields.description_zh:
0：不正確、1：正確、2：不識字、
3：看不清楚或識字不多、4：受訪者失明

fields.description_en:
0: Incorrect, 1: Correct, 2: Illiterate,
3: Cannot see clearly or limited literacy, 4: Respondent is blind

fields.name_zh_en: Writing: Write a complete sentence on the paper: (the sentence must be semantically complete)
fields.description_en: 0: Incorrect, 1: Correct, 2: Upper limb dysfunction, 3: Illiterate or unable to write

fields.name_zh: 【訪員填寫】請問前一題(G10.請受訪者寫出一個句子)，是不是經提示後才寫出？
fields.description_zh: 1：未經提示即寫出句子、2：經提示後寫出句子

fields.description_en: 1: Wrote the sentence without prompting, 2: Wrote the sentence after prompting

fields.name_zh: 畫圖：這裡有個圖形請在旁邊畫出一個相同的圖形
fields.description_zh: 0：不正確、1：正確、2：上肢功能障礙、3：受訪者失明
fields.name_zh_en: Drawing: Here is a figure; please draw an identical figure next to it
fields.description_en: 0: Incorrect, 1: Correct, 2: Upper limb dysfunction, 3: Respondent is blind

fields.name_zh: 【訪員填寫】受訪者意識程度的評估
fields.description_zh: 1：清醒/有反應、2：呆滯、3：恍惚、4：昏睡狀態/無反應
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer to fill in] Assessment of the respondent's level of consciousness

fields.name_zh: 您從以前到現在有沒有工作過？
fields.description_zh: 1：未曾工作過、2：現在沒有，但以前有工作過、3：目前仍有在工作
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever worked before?
fields.description_en: 1: Never worked, 2: Not currently working but worked before, 3: Currently working

fields.name_zh: 您為什麼沒有工作呢？
fields.description_zh: 1：家管、2：學生、3：無工作能力、4：其他原因
fields.name_zh_en: Why don't you have a job?
fields.description_en: 1: Homemaker, 2: Student, 3: Unable to work, 4: Other reasons

fields.name_zh: 後來為什麼沒有在工作了呢？
fields.description_zh: 1：退休或年紀大了、2：健康的問題，不能繼續工作、3：工作不適應、4：公司裁員或關閉遷移等，被遣散、5：收入不滿意、6：生意失敗/經濟不景氣，利潤太差、7：學生、8：家庭因素：結婚或照顧家裡小孩子的關係、9：其他因素
fields.name_zh_en: Why did you later stop working?
fields.description_en: 1: Retired or old age, 2: Health problems, cannot continue working, 3: Could not adjust to the job, 4: Laid off due to company downsizing, closure, relocation, etc., 5: Dissatisfied with income, 6: Business failure/economic downturn, poor profits, 7: Student, 8: Family reasons: marriage or caring for young children, 9: Other reasons

fields.name_zh: 請問您目前有幾個工作？（包括主、副業）
fields.name_zh_en: How many jobs do you currently have? (Including main and side jobs)

fields.name_zh: 請問您目前的主要工作狀況？
fields.description_zh: 1：全時間工作、2：部分時間工作、3：學生
fields.name_zh_en: What is your current main work status?

fields.name_zh: 您的工作是屬於政府雇用、民間雇用、自己就是雇主也有員工，或是沒有員工的自營事業？
fields.description_zh: 1：政府雇用、2：民間雇用、3：自營 (下無員工)、4：雇主 (下有員工)
fields.name_zh_en: Is your job employed by government, employed by private sector, employer with employees, or self-employed without employees?
fields.description_en: 1: Employed by government, 2: Employed by private sector, 3: Self-employed (no employees), 4: Employer (with employees)

fields.name_zh: 您是否經銓敍部銓敍審定？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you been reviewed and certified by the Ministry of Civil Service?

fields.name_zh: 您這份主要工作，共雇用多少員工？
fields.name_zh_en: How many employees does your main job employ?
fields.description_en: 1: Fewer than 30 people, 2: 30 or more people

fields.name_zh: 請問您平常"每週"工作幾個小時？(包括主、副業,但排除通勤時間)
fields.name_zh_en: How many hours do you usually work "per week"? (Including main and side jobs, excluding commuting time)

fields.name_zh: 您"最近一個月"有無參加全民健保？
fields.description_zh: 0：從未加入健保、1：有參加健保、2：中斷健保

fields.description_en: 0: Never enrolled in NHI, 1: Enrolled in NHI, 2: NHI coverage interrupted

fields.name_zh_en: employer refusal to enroll in insurance

fields.name_zh_en: income stability or too low

fields.name_zh_en: unemployment

fields.name_zh_en: Did not know about National Health Insurance

fields.name_zh_en: how to insure

fields.name_zh_en: backlogged premium unable to insure

fields.name_zh: 覺得保費太貴
fields.name_zh_en: find insurance premium too expensive

fields.name_zh: 已有其他商業保險
fields.name_zh_en: already have other commercial insurance

fields.name_zh: 工作轉換尚未投保
fields.name_zh_en: not insured after job change

fields.name_zh: 身體健康不需投保
fields.name_zh_en: In good health, no need for insurance

fields.name_zh: 長期出國
fields.name_zh_en: long-term travel abroad

fields.name_zh: 受刑人
fields.name_zh_en: prisoner

fields.name_zh: 家庭因素(例如：可依附投保之家人失和/離異/去世)
fields.name_zh_en: Family factors (e.g., estrangement/divorce/death of the family member under whose insurance one could be covered)

fields.name_zh: 其他原因
fields.name_zh_en: other reasons

fields.name_zh: "過去一年"，您"平均一個月"的收入（包括薪資、租金、投資所得、子女給的、父母給的、社會救助、退休金等），大約有多少？
fields.description_zh: 0：沒有收入、1：未滿5千元、2：5 千元～未滿 1 萬元、3：1 萬元～未滿 1 萬 5 千元、4：1 萬 5 千元～未滿 2 萬元、5：2 萬元～未滿 4 萬元、6：4 萬元～未滿 6 萬元、7：6 萬元～未滿 8萬元、8：8 萬元～未滿 10 萬元、9：10 萬元及以上
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year", about how much was your income "per month on average" (including salary, rent, investment income, money from children, money from parents, social assistance, pension, etc.)?
fields.description_en: 0: No income, 1: Less than 5,000 yuan, 2: 5,000 to less than 10,000 yuan, 3: 10,000 to less than 15,000 yuan, 4: 15,000 to less than 20,000 yuan, 5: 20,000 to less than 40,000 yuan, 6: 40,000 to less than 60,000 yuan, 7: 60,000 to less than 80,000 yuan, 8: 80,000 to less than 100,000 yuan, 9: 100,000 yuan or more

fields.name_zh: "過去一年"，您"家中的收入"全部算在一起（包括薪資、租金、投資所得、子女給的、父母給的、社會救助、退休金等），"平均一個月"大約有多少？
fields.description_zh:
1：未滿3萬元、2：3 萬元～未滿5萬元、3：5萬元～未滿 7 萬元、
4：7 萬元～未滿 10 萬元、5：10萬元～未滿 15 萬元、6：15 萬元～未滿 20 萬元、7：20 萬元及以上
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past year", taking all your "household income" together (including salary, rent, investment income, money from children, money from parents, social assistance, pension, etc.), about how much is it "on average per month"?
fields.description_en:
1: Less than 30,000 yuan, 2: 30,000 to less than 50,000 yuan, 3: 50,000 to less than 70,000 yuan,
4: 70,000 to less than 100,000 yuan, 5: 100,000 to less than 150,000 yuan, 6: 150,000 to less than 200,000 yuan, 7: 200,000 yuan or more

fields.name_zh: 請問您(和您先生/太太)最近一年"最主要"的收入來源是哪一項？
fields.description_zh:
1：自己的工作收入、2：配偶的工作收入、3：老人年金、養老金、退休、撫卹金或保險金、4：租金、利息或股票、房地產交易所得、
5：自家或家族事業之收入、6：農、林、漁、牧事業之收入、7：子女或其他親戚給的、8：社會福利救濟金、政府補助金、低收入津貼、敬老金等、9：其他來源
fields.name_zh_en: What was the "main" source of income for you (and your husband/wife) in the past year?
fields.description_en:
1: Own work income, 2: Spouse's work income, 3: Old-age pension, retirement, survivor benefits, or insurance payments, 4: Rent, interest, or income from stock or real estate transactions,
5: Income from own or family business, 6: Income from agriculture, forestry, fishery, or livestock business, 7: Given by children or other relatives, 8: Social welfare relief, government subsidies, low-income allowance, senior respect allowance, etc., 9: Other sources

fields.name_zh: 您(和您先生/太太)最近一年"次要"的收入來源是哪一項？
fields.description_zh: 0：沒有次要收入來源、1：自己的工作收入、2：配偶的工作收入、3：老人年金、養老金、退休、撫卹金或保險金、4：租金、利息或股票、房地產交易所得、5：自家或家族事業之收入、6：農、林、漁、牧事業之收入、7：子女或其他親戚給的、8：社會福利救濟金、政府補助金、低收入津貼、敬老金等、9：其他來源
fields.name_zh_en: What was the "secondary" source of income for you (and your husband/wife) in the past year?
fields.description_en: 0: No secondary source of income, 1: Own work income, 2: Spouse's work income, 3: Old-age pension, retirement, survivor benefits, or insurance payments, 4: Rent, interest, or income from stock or real estate transactions, 5: Income from own or family business, 6: Income from agriculture, forestry, fishery, or livestock business, 7: Given by children or other relatives, 8: Social welfare relief, government subsidies, low-income allowance, senior respect allowance, etc., 9: Other sources

fields.name_zh: 整體而言，您對您目前的經濟狀況滿不滿意？
fields.description_zh: 1：非常不滿意、2：不太滿意、3：普通、4：滿意、5：非常滿意
fields.name_zh_en: Overall, are you satisfied with your current financial situation?
fields.description_en: 1: Very dissatisfied, 2: Not very satisfied, 3: Fair, 4: Satisfied, 5: Very satisfied

fields.name_zh: 請問您(和您先生/太太)在應付每個月的生活費用或開支上，是否足夠或有困難？
fields.description_zh: 1：相當困難、2：略有困難、3：大致夠用，不感覺欠缺、4：相當充裕而有餘
fields.name_zh_en: Are you (and your spouse) able to cover monthly living expenses, or do you have difficulty?
fields.description_en: 1: Quite difficult, 2: Slightly difficult, 3: Generally sufficient, do not feel a shortage, 4: Quite plentiful with surplus

fields.name_zh: 請問您目前有沒有一支或一支以上有效的手機門號？（以過去一個月有撥打，且現在沒有停話的門號為準）
fields.name_zh_en: Do you currently have one or more active mobile phone numbers? (Based on numbers used to make calls in the past month that are not currently disconnected)

fields.name_zh: 過去一個月，請問您總共使用多少支手機門號？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past month, how many mobile phone numbers did you use in total?

fields.name_zh: 請問您家中現在有沒有至少一支以上可以使用的"家用電話號碼"？（不包括手機、傳真或上網專用電話）
fields.name_zh_en: Does your home currently have at least one usable "home telephone number"? (Excluding mobile phones, fax lines or lines used only for Internet access)

fields.name_zh: 是否簽署全民健保資料比對與連結同意？
fields.name_zh_en: Did you sign consent for NHI data matching and linkage?

fields.name_zh: "樣本個案本人"之身心狀況：身體狀況
fields.description_zh:
1：無異常、2：坐輪椅、3：臥床、
4：其他身體不佳狀況
fields.name_zh_en: Physical and mental condition of the "sample case himself/herself": physical condition
fields.description_en:
1: No abnormality, 2: Uses a wheelchair, 3: Bedridden,
4: Other poor physical condition

fields.name_zh: 無異常
fields.name_zh_en: normal

fields.name_zh: 重聽
fields.name_zh_en: deafness

fields.name_zh: 耳聾
fields.name_zh_en: deafness

fields.name_zh: 啞巴
fields.name_zh_en: deaf

fields.name_zh: 其他溝通不良情況
fields.name_zh_en: Other communication difficulties

fields.name_zh: "樣本個案本人"之身心狀況：心智狀況
fields.description_zh:
1：無異常、2：失智(包括弱智)、
3：精神異常、4：無意識(包括完全昏迷)、5：其他心智不佳狀況
fields.name_zh_en: Physical and mental condition of the "sample case himself/herself": mental condition
fields.description_en:
1: No abnormality, 2: Dementia (including intellectual disability),
3: Mental disorder, 4: Unconscious (including complete coma), 5: Other poor mental condition

fields.name_zh: 這一本問卷的訪問對象是？
fields.description_zh: 1：樣本個案本人、2：代答者、3：樣本個案本人與代答者
fields.name_zh_en: Who is the respondent of this questionnaire?
fields.description_en: 1: Sampled case himself/herself, 2: Proxy respondent, 3: Sampled case himself/herself and proxy respondent

fields.name_zh: 尋求代答的主要原因是？
fields.description_zh: 1：重病或身體虛弱體力無法支持、2：嚴重的精神或心智障礙導致無法溝通、3：重聽、耳聾、啞巴或無法溝通、4：無法記憶、5：其他原因
fields.name_zh_en: What is the main reason for seeking a proxy respondent?
fields.description_en: 1: Serious illness or physical weakness with insufficient strength, 2: Severe mental or cognitive disorder preventing communication, 3: Hard of hearing, deaf, mute, or unable to communicate, 4: Unable to remember, 5: Other reasons

fields.name_zh: 代答者是樣本個案的什麼人？
fields.description_zh:
1：父親、2：母親、3：配偶、4：媳婦、5：女婿、6：(外)孫子女、
7：兒子、8：女兒、9：配偶父親、
10：配偶母親、11：其他親戚、
12：其他非親戚
fields.name_zh_en: What is the proxy respondent's relationship to the sample case?
fields.description_en:
1: Father, 2: Mother, 3: Spouse, 4: Daughter-in-law, 5: Son-in-law, 6: Grandchild (paternal/maternal),
7: Son, 8: Daughter, 9: Spouse's father,
10: Spouse's mother, 11: Other relatives,
12: Other non-relatives
